quests.title: The Great Mountain Survey

dialogue.t: There's no way this is enough beacons to survey the whole mountain...
Let me see... Yes, these are the ones, alright!
Ugh, look at the state of them... Those monsters clearly weren't gentle with them. But thankfully, they're not completely ruined.
*sigh* Still, I guess I won't be using them in the near future... Ah, can't be helped. I will have to make do with a smaller-scale survey...
I have some other beacons here. Could you set them up on the mountain for me?

dialogue.sit: Why can't you do it yourself?

dialogue.t: ...Is that a yes? I'll take that as a yes! Thanks! I'll mark the spot on the map for you.
...There. I've marked them all out. Just put the beacons in those general areas.
Make sure to put them up in high spots. The higher the altitude, the more accurate the survey.
This beacon is useless... So's this one...
Are all the beacons in place?
Wonderful, that is an enormous help. Take these — along with my thanks, once again, for everything.
Ugh, with so few beacons for the survey, who knows if I'll be able to turn up anything of interest...

quests.description: The environmentalist Esther and the expedition team with her were set upon by monsters while performing a mountain survey, with the larger part of her survey beacons being lost in the process. She is currently looking for someone who can get them back for her…
